title: The d-form f·ι_z(dy) on ℝ^{d+1} has exterior derivative (∂_z f)·dy
statement: Let d ∈ ℕ and z ∈ ℝ^{d+1} = Euclid (d+1). There is a d-covector ε on ℝ^{d+1} with |ε| ≤ ‖z‖ (|·| = covectorEuclideanNorm) such that for every f : ℝ^{d+1} → ℝ and every y at which f is differentiable, the exterior derivative of the d-form x ↦ f(x)·ε satisfies d(f·ε)(y)(e_0, …, e_d) = Df(y)(z), where e_i = EuclideanSpace.single i 1.
lean_statement: ∀ (d : ℕ) (z : Euclid (d + 1)), ∃ ε : Covector (Euclid (d + 1)) d, covectorEuclideanNorm ε ≤ ‖z‖ ∧ ∀ (f : Euclid (d + 1) → ℝ) (y : Euclid (d + 1)), DifferentiableAt ℝ f y → exteriorDerivative (fun x => f x • ε) y (fun i => EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) = fderiv ℝ f y z
